questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: A trader buys 25 articles for ₹20 and sells 20 articles for ₹25. What is the profit percentage?
questions.hi: एक व्यापारी 25 वस्तुएं ₹20 में खरीदता है और 20 वस्तुएं ₹25 में बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Cost price of 1 article = 20/25 = ₹0.80. Selling price of 1 article = 25/20 = ₹1.25. Profit per article = 1.25 - 0.80 = ₹0.45. Profit % = (0.45 / 0.80) * 100 = 56.25%.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Cost price of 1 अनुच्छेद = 20/25 = ₹0.80. Selling price of 1 अनुच्छेद = 25/20 = ₹1.25. Profit per अनुच्छेद = 1.25 - 0.80 = ₹0.45. Profit % = (0.45 / 0.80) * 100 = 56.25%.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹65. What is the principal sum?
questions.hi: किसी धनराशि पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष के चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ₹65 है। वह धनराशि क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.tip: Standard 2-year difference formula: P = D * (100/R)^2 = 65 * 100 = ₹6,500.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.tip_hi: Standard 2-वर्ष difference formula: P = D * (100/R)^2 = 65 * 100 = ₹6,500.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their Least Common Multiple (LCM) is 180. The smaller of the two numbers is(
questions.hi: दो संख्याएं 3 : 4 के अनुपात में हैं और उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) 180 है। उनमें छोटी संख्या है)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 3x and 4x. Their LCM = 3 * 4 * x = 12x. Given 12x = 180, so x = 15. The smaller number = 3x = 3 * 15 = 45. The larger number is 4x = 60.
questions.tip: Factor check: 180 / (3 * 4) = 15 = HCF. Smaller number = 15 * 3 = 45.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Let the numbers be 3x and 4x. Their LCM = 3 * 4 * x = 12x. Given 12x = 180, so x = 15. The smaller number = 3x = 3 * 15 = 45. The larger number is 4x = 60.
questions.tip_hi: Factor check: 180 / (3 * 4) = 15 = HCF. Smaller number = 15 * 3 = 45.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: The average of five consecutive odd numbers is 61. What is the difference between the highest and lowest numbers?
questions.hi: पाँच क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं का औसत 61 है। उच्चतम और निम्नतम संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In five consecutive odd numbers, the average (61) is the middle (3rd) number. The numbers are 57, 59, 61, 63, 65. Difference = 65 - 57 = 8.
questions.tip: For 'n' consecutive odd or even numbers, the difference between highest and lowest is always 2 * (n - 1) = 2 * 4 = 8.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: In five consecutive odd numbers, the average (61) is the middle (3rd) number. The numbers are 57, 59, 61, 63, 65. Difference = 65 - 57 = 8.
questions.tip_hi: For 'n' consecutive odd or even numbers, the difference between highest and lowest is always 2 * (n - 1) = 2 * 4 = 8.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Sound waves cannot propagate through which of the following media?
questions.hi: ध्वनि तरंगें निम्नलिखित में से किस माध्यम में संचरण नहीं कर सकती हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sound waves are mechanical longitudinal waves that require a material medium with inertia and elasticity to propagate. Sound cannot travel through vacuum, whereas electromagnetic waves (light) can.
questions.tip: Speed of sound: Solids > Liquids > Gases > Vacuum (zero).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: ध्वनि तरंगें are mechanical longitudinal waves that require a material medium with inertia and elasticity to propagate. Sound cannot travel through निर्वात, जबकि electromagnetic waves (light) can.
questions.tip_hi: Speed of sound: ठोस > द्रव > गैस > निर्वात (zero).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: A train 240 metres long crosses a platform of length 260 metres in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.hi: 240 मीटर लंबी एक रेलगाड़ी 260 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को 25 सेकंड में पार करती है। रेलगाड़ी की गति किमी/घंटा में क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Total distance covered = Length of train + Length of platform = 240 + 260 = 500 m. Time taken = 25 seconds. Speed = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s. Converting to km/h = 20 * (18/5) = 72 km/h.
questions.tip: Distance = Train + Platform = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s * 18/5 = 72 km/h.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Total distance covered = Length of train + Length of platform = 240 + 260 = 500 m. Time taken = 25 सेकंड. Speed = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s. Converting to किमी/h = 20 * (18/5) = 72 किमी/h.
questions.tip_hi: Distance = Train + Platform = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s * 18/5 = 72 किमी/h.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: If a sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest, in how many years will it become 4 times of itself at the same rate?
questions.hi: यदि कोई धनराशि साधारण ब्याज पर 5 वर्ष में दोगुनी हो जाती है, तो उसी दर पर वह कितने वर्षों में 4 गुनी हो जाएगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let principal = P. Doubling means SI = P in 5 years. For becoming 4 times, amount = 4P, so SI = 3P. Since SI is directly proportional to time: Time = 3 * 5 = 15 years.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Let principal = P. Doubling means SI = P in 5 वर्ष. For becoming 4 times, amount = 4P, so SI = 3P. Since SI is directly proportional to time: Time = 3 * 5 = 15 वर्ष.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B can do it in 18 days. If they work together for 4 days, what fraction of work remains to be finished?
questions.hi: A किसी कार्य को 12 दिनों में और B उसे 18 दिनों में कर सकता है। यदि वे 4 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य करते हैं, तो कार्य का कितना भाग शेष रह जाएगा?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: LCM of 12 and 18 = 36 units total work. A's efficiency = 3 units/day, B's efficiency = 2 units/day. Together in 4 days = 4 * (3 + 2) = 20 units. Remaining work = 36 - 20 = 16 units. Remaining fraction = 16/36 = 4/9.
questions.tip: 1-day combined work = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36. In 4 days = 20/36. Remaining = 1 - 20/36 = 16/36 = 4/9.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: LCM of 12 and 18 = 36 units total work. A's efficiency = 3 units/दिन, B's efficiency = 2 units/दिन. Together in 4 दिन = 4 * (3 + 2) = 20 units. Remaining work = 36 - 20 = 16 units. Remaining fraction = 16/36 = 4/9.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: The perimeter of a rectangular field is 80 metres and its length is 8 metres more than its breadth. What is the area of the field?
questions.hi: एक आयताकार मैदान का परिमाप 80 मीटर है और उसकी लंबाई उसकी चौड़ाई से 8 मीटर अधिक है। मैदान का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(L + B) = 80 => L + B = 40. Given L = B + 8. So (B + 8) + B = 40 => 2B = 32 => B = 16 m, L = 24 m. Area = L * B = 24 * 16 = 384 sq metres.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Perimeter = 2(L + B) = 80 => L + B = 40. Given L = B + 8. So (B + 8) + B = 40 => 2B = 32 => B = 16 m, L = 24 m. Area = L * B = 24 * 16 = 384 sq metres.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: The twinkling of stars in the night sky is an optical manifestation of
questions.hi: रात्रि के समय तारों का टिमटिमाना किस प्रकाशिक घटना का परिणाम है?
options: Atmospheric Refraction of starlight through air layers of varying optical density
Periodic Dispersion of starlight by cloud moisture
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Atmospheric Refraction of starlight through air layers of varying optical density
questions.explanation: As starlight travels through different layers of Earth's atmosphere having continuously varying physical temperatures and refractive indices, the path of light bends continuously, causing apparent fluctuations in brightness and position.
questions.tip: Star twinkling = Atmospheric Refraction; Advanced sunrise & delayed sunset = Atmospheric Refraction.
options_hi: Atmospheric अपवर्तन of starlight through air layers of varying optical density
Periodic वर्ण विक्षेपण of starlight by cloud moisture
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: As starlight travels through different layers of Earth's atmosphere having continuously varying physical temperatures and refractive indices, the path of light bends continuously, causing apparent fluctuations in brightness and position.
questions.tip_hi: Star twinkling = Atmospheric अपवर्तन; Advanced sunrise & delayed sunset = Atmospheric अपवर्तन.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: What is the pH value of pure water at 25°C?
questions.hi: 25°C पर शुद्ध जल का pH मान क्या होता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pure neutral water has equal concentrations of H+ and OH- ions (10^-7 mol/L each at 25°C), yielding pH = -log[H+] = 7. Solutions with pH < 7 are acidic, and pH > 7 are alkaline.
questions.tip: Neutral pH = 7. Human blood pH = 7.35–7.45; Acid rain pH < 5.6.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Pure उदासीन water has equal concentrations of H+ and OH- ions (10^-7 mol/L each at 25°C), yielding pH = -log[H+] = 7. Solutions with pH < 7 are अम्लीय, and pH > 7 are alkaline.
questions.tip_hi: उदासीन pH = 7. Human blood pH = 7.35–7.45; Acid rain pH < 5.6.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: According to Lindeman's 10% Ecological Law, how much energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next higher trophic level?
questions.hi: लिंडमैन के 10% पारिस्थितिक नियम के अनुसार, एक पोषी स्तर से अगले उच्च पोषी स्तर तक कितनी ऊर्जा स्थानांतरित होती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Formulated by Raymond Lindeman in 1942, during energy transfer from an organic food source to a consumer, approximately 90% of energy is lost as metabolic heat and respiration, leaving only ~10% stored as flesh for the next trophic level.
questions.tip: Energy transfer between trophic levels is always ~10%; restricts food chains to 4-5 links.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Formulated by Raymond Lindeman in 1942, के दौरान energy transfer from an organic food source to a consumer, approximately 90% of energy is lost as metabolic heat and श्वसन, leaving only ~10% stored as flesh for the next trophic level.
questions.tip_hi: Energy transfer between trophic levels is always ~10%; restricts food chains to 4-5 links.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Which emergency evacuation mission was executed by the Government of India in 2022 to evacuate Indian citizens stranded during the conflict in Ukraine?
questions.hi: 2022 में यूक्रेन युद्ध के दौरान फंसे भारतीय नागरिकों को सुरक्षित निकालने के लिए भारत सरकार द्वारा कौन-सा राहत अभियान चलाया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operation Ganga was launched in late February 2022 to evacuate ~20,000 Indian nationals, primarily medical students, from war-torn Ukraine through neighbouring countries (Poland, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia).
questions.tip: Operation Ganga = Ukraine (2022); Operation Devi Shakti = Afghanistan (2021); Operation Kaveri = Sudan (2023).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Operation गंगा नदी was launched in late फरवरी 2022 to evacuate ~20,000 Indian nationals, primarily medical students, from war-torn Ukraine through neighbouring countries (Poland, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia).
questions.tip_hi: Operation गंगा नदी = Ukraine (2022); Operation Devi Shakti = Afghanistan (2021); Operation Kaveri = Sudan (2023).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: A car travels at a speed of 54 km/h. How many metres does it travel in 20 seconds?
questions.hi: एक कार 54 किमी/घंटा की गति से चल रही है। वह 20 सेकंड में कितने मीटर की दूरी तय करेगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Speed in m/s = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Distance = Speed * Time = 15 m/s * 20 s = 300 metres.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Speed in m/s = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Distance = Speed * Time = 15 m/s * 20 s = 300 metres.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: If the radius of a circle is decreased by 50%, by what percentage does its area decrease?
questions.hi: यदि किसी वृत्त की त्रिज्या 50% घटा दी जाए, तो उसके क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी होगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Area of circle is proportional to r^2. If r becomes 0.5r, new area = (0.5)^2 * original area = 0.25 * original area. Percentage reduction = (1 - 0.25) * 100 = 75%.
questions.tip: Successive percentage formula: -50 - 50 + (-50*-50)/100 = -100 + 25 = -75%.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Area of circle is proportional to r^2. If r becomes 0.5r, new area = (0.5)^2 * original area = 0.25 * original area. प्रतिशत reduction = (1 - 0.25) * 100 = 75%.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: In an election between two candidates, the winner received 58% of the total valid votes and won by a majority of 1,600 votes. What was the total number of valid votes polled?
questions.hi: दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच एक चुनाव में, विजेता को कुल वैध मतों का 58% प्राप्त हुआ और वह 1,600 मतों के बहुमत से जीता। कुल वैध मतों की संख्या क्या थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Winner's vote % = 58%. Loser's vote % = 100 - 58 = 42%. Difference = 58% - 42% = 16%. Given 16% of total votes = 1,600. Total valid votes = (1,600 / 16) * 100 = 10,000.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Winner's vote % = 58%. Loser's vote % = 100 - 58 = 42%. Difference = 58% - 42% = 16%. Given 16% of total votes = 1,600. Total valid votes = (1,600 / 16) * 100 = 10,000.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: If x + 1/x = 4, then what is the value of x^2 + 1/x^2?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Squaring both sides: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2 = 4^2 = 16. Therefore, x^2 + 1/x^2 = 16 - 2 = 14.
questions.tip: Standard identity: If x + 1/x = k, then x^2 + 1/x^2 = k^2 - 2 = 4^2 - 2 = 14.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Squaring both sides: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2 = 4^2 = 16. Therefore, x^2 + 1/x^2 = 16 - 2 = 14.
questions.tip_hi: Standard identity: If x + 1/x = k, then x^2 + 1/x^2 = k^2 - 2 = 4^2 - 2 = 14.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: Two pipes A and B can fill a cistern in 20 minutes and 30 minutes respectively. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, in how much time will the cistern be completely filled?
questions.hi: दो नल A और B किसी टंकी को क्रमशः 20 मिनट और 30 मिनट में भर सकते हैं। यदि दोनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो टंकी कितने समय में पूरी भर जाएगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Combined rate = (1/20 + 1/30) = (3 + 2)/60 = 5/60 = 1/12 of cistern per minute. Time required = 12 minutes.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Combined rate = (1/20 + 1/30) = (3 + 2)/60 = 5/60 = 1/12 of cistern per मिनट. Time required = 12 मिनट.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: At constant temperature, the volume of a given mass of dry gas is inversely proportional to its pressure. This fundamental gas law is known as
questions.hi: नियत तापमान पर, किसी गैस के निश्चित द्रव्यमान का आयतन उसके दाब के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है। यह नियम कहलाता है
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Formulated by Robert Boyle in 1662, Boyle's law states that at constant temperature (T), P * V = constant, meaning pressure and volume vary inversely. Charles's law relates volume and temperature at constant pressure.
questions.tip: Constant T => Boyle's Law (P ∝ 1/V); Constant P => Charles's Law (V ∝ T).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Formulated by Robert Boyle in 1662, Boyle's law states that at constant temperature (T), P * V = constant, meaning pressure and volume vary inversely. Charles's law relates volume and temperature at constant pressure.
questions.tip_hi: Constant T => Boyle's Law (P ∝ 1/V); Constant P => Charles's Law (V ∝ T).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: The historic peasant agitation known as the 'Bakhasht Movement' was organized in the Barahiya Tal area of Munger under the leadership of
questions.hi: मुंगेर के बड़हिया टाल क्षेत्र में ऐतिहासिक 'बकाश्त आंदोलन' का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: If a train runs at 40 km/h, it reaches its destination late by 11 minutes, but if it runs at 50 km/h, it is late by only 5 minutes. The correct journey distance is
questions.hi: यदि एक रेलगाड़ी 40 किमी/घंटा की गति से चले तो 11 मिनट की देरी से पहुँचती है, परन्तु यदि 50 किमी/घंटा की गति से चले तो केवल 5 मिनट की देरी होती है। यात्रा की सही दूरी क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Time difference = 11 - 5 = 6 minutes = 6/60 hour = 1/10 hour. Formula: Distance = (S1 * S2) / (S2 - S1) * Time difference = (40 * 50) / (50 - 40) * (1/10) = 2000 / 10 * 1/10 = 20 km.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Time difference = 11 - 5 = 6 मिनट = 6/60 घंटे = 1/10 घंटे. Formula: Distance = (S1 * S2) / (S2 - S1) * Time difference = (40 * 50) / (50 - 40) * (1/10) = 2000 / 10 * 1/10 = 20 किमी.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: The ratio of ages of father and son at present is 7 : 2. After 10 years, the ratio of their ages will be 9 : 4. What is the present age of the father?
questions.hi: वर्तमान में पिता और पुत्र की आयु का अनुपात 7 : 2 है। 10 वर्ष बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात 9 : 4 होगा। पिता की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let present ages be 7x and 2x. In 10 years: (7x + 10)/(2x + 10) = 9/4 => 4(7x + 10) = 9(2x + 10) => 28x + 40 = 18x + 90 => 10x = 50 => x = 5. Father's age = 7x = 7 * 5 = 35 years.
questions.tip: Ratio units: (9-7)=2 units in 10 years => 1 unit = 5 years. Father = 7 units = 35 years.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.tip_hi: Ratio units: (9-7)=2 units in 10 वर्ष => 1 unit = 5 वर्ष. Father = 7 units = 35 वर्ष.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 1 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: In a mixture of 60 litres, the ratio of milk and water is 2 : 1. How much water must be added to make the ratio of milk to water 1 : 2?
questions.hi: 60 लीटर के मिश्रण में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 2 : 1 है। इस अनुपात को 1 : 2 करने के लिए इसमें कितना पानी मिलाना होगा?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In 60 litres: Milk = 40 L, Water = 20 L. Let 'x' litres of water be added. (40) / (20 + x) = 1/2 => 20 + x = 80 => x = 60 litres.
questions.tip: Milk remains constant at 40 L. In 1:2 ratio, 1 unit = 40 L, so water must be 2 units = 80 L. Added water = 80 - 20 = 60 L.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: In 60 लीटर: Milk = 40 L, Water = 20 L. Let 'x' लीटर of water be added. (40) / (20 + x) = 1/2 => 20 + x = 80 => x = 60 लीटर.
questions.tip_hi: Milk remains constant at 40 L. In 1:2 ratio, 1 unit = 40 L, so water must be 2 units = 80 L. Added water = 80 - 20 = 60 L.

questions.en: Who founded the 'All India Depressed Classes League' in 1935 and served as a veteran freedom fighter and Deputy Prime Minister of India?
questions.hi: 1935 में 'ऑल इंडिया डिप्रेस्ड क्लासेज लीग' की स्थापना किसने की थी जो वरिष्ठ स्वतंत्रता सेनानी और भारत के उप-प्रधानमंत्री भी रहे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Babu Jagjivan Ram, born in Chandwa (Bhojpur, Bihar), founded the All India Depressed Classes League in 1935 to mobilize scheduled castes for national independence and civil rights.
questions.tip: All India Depressed Classes League (1935) = Babu Jagjivan Ram; All India Scheduled Castes Federation = Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC TRE 1.0 - Primary Shift 2 (Advt. 21/2023)
questions.en: A sum of money invested at simple interest triples itself in 8 years. In how many years will it become 9 times of itself at the same annual rate of interest?
questions.hi: कोई धनराशि साधारण ब्याज पर 8 वर्षों में तीन गुनी हो जाती है। समान वार्षिक ब्याज दर पर वह कितने वर्षों में 9 गुनी हो जाएगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: For tripling, SI = 2P in 8 years, so interest rate = 2P/(P * 8) = 25%. For becoming 9 times, SI = 8P. Time = 8P / (P * 0.25) = 32 years.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: For tripling, SI = 2P in 8 वर्ष, so interest rate = 2P/(P * 8) = 25%. For becoming 9 times, SI = 8P. Time = 8P / (P * 0.25) = 32 वर्ष.
